metrics.label: Stockout avoided units
metrics.description: Units protected from stockout by approved transfer, replacement, or recovery work.
metrics.timeWindow: Single captured outcome event effective time.

attribution.rule: Credit the approved recovery loop whose correlation id matches the captured outcome event.
attribution.limitations: This MVP metric is directly observed in the outcome fixture; production should reconcile stock ledgers before final reporting.

metrics.label: Waste reduction units
metrics.description: Near-expiry or at-risk units rotated, marked down, quarantined, or otherwise prevented from avoidable waste.
metrics.timeWindow: Single captured outcome event effective time.

attribution.rule: Credit the approved recovery loop whose correlation id matches the captured outcome event.
attribution.limitations: This MVP metric is directly observed in the outcome fixture; production should reconcile inventory and disposal records.

metrics.label: Readiness score delta
metrics.description: Point improvement between the observed starting readiness score and the post-action readiness score.
metrics.formula: Extract 'readiness score increased from X to Y' from data.attributes.actual_outcomes and calculate Y - X.
metrics.timeWindow: Single captured outcome event effective time.

attribution.rule: Credit the approved nurture and handoff loop whose correlation id matches the captured outcome event.
attribution.limitations: This MVP metric is extracted from structured fixture text; production should store readiness scores as typed source attributes.
